numerical_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Financial Position (page 13) reports total assets of EUR 476.3 million at 31 December 2024 and EUR 421.3 million at 31 December 2023.

numerical_claims.claim: Total equity increased significantly to EUR 108.1 million from EUR 65.4 million.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Financial Position (page 15) shows equity attributable to equity holders of the Parent Company of EUR 108.1 million at 31 December 2024 and EUR 65.4 million at 31 December 2023.

numerical_claims.claim: Total liabilities stood at EUR 355.9 million, down from EUR 368.2 million in the previous year, with total borrowings amounting to EUR 339.6 million.
numerical_claims.candidate_value: EUR 355.9 million (2024 liabilities), EUR 368.2 million (2023); EUR 339.6 million (2024 borrowings)
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Financial Position (page 15) lists total liabilities of EUR 355.9 million for 2024 and EUR 368.2 million for 2023; Note 35 (page 56) shows borrowings principal of EUR 339.6 million at 31 December 2024.

numerical_claims.claim: The successful initial public offering completed in October 2024 on Nasdaq Riga and the Frankfurt Stock Exchange raised EUR 29.0 million in equity.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Management report page 131 and Note 33 page 55 confirm the October 2024 IPO raised EUR 29.0 million.

numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Note 33 page 55 details the issuance of 17,058,824 new shares during the October 2024 IPO.

numerical_claims.claim: A tax audit in Romania resulted in additional VAT liabilities of EUR 3.0 million for the period between 2017 and 2022.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Note 34 page 132 reports additional VAT liability of EUR 3.0 million assessed by Romanian Tax Authority for 2017-2022.

numerical_claims.claim: The additional VAT liability reduced net profit by EUR 2.6 million.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Note 34 page 132 states the EUR 3.0 million VAT liability impacted net profit by EUR 2.6 million after tax.
